QUARTILE PROFILE

How does connectivity vary by class?

Bar length shows mean degree within each class. Quartile is a supplied node label; degree is calculated from the displayed route network.

READING THE VIEW

What the diagram establishes.

Position
Derived from network adjacency with a force-directed layout. Nearby marks are not necessarily geographically close.
Color
Flight-activity quartile, shown as Q1–Q4 while retaining raw labels 0–3.
Size
Degree: the count of unique commercial-route connections in this undirected graph.
Limits
No airport names, route frequency, direction, distance, time, or geography are included.
